svg.title: Learn the pairs. Freeze the order.
svg.desc: Four word types have counts 5, 2, 3, 1; each contains the adjacent pair c,a, giving first-round count 11. The five frozen merge ranks are 0 through 4, with selection counts 11,7,5,4,3. The unseen word catt is encoded using ranks 0 and 1 only, preserving token spans. Its second t separates cat from the word-end marker, blocking rank 2. Final teaching IDs are 7,5,0; ID 0 is the word-end marker, not EOS.
svg.text: Learn the pairs. Freeze the order.
Training learns rules; encoding only reads them. Counts, ranks, and token IDs are distinct.
Wins round 1; recount after every merge.
n = pair count when the merge was selected
Match adjacent pairs only; preserve their spans as symbols merge.
IDs = [7, 5, 0]. ID ≠ rank; ID 0 is the word-end marker here, not EOS.
